about: Round 2 of the src/ m-r workshop-tool rows of docs/worker-retirement-port-backlog.json that still had no home on main. The groups are those of move-rows/trillion-tools-m-z-scripts-parts.json that own one of those files; a group that was held as a whole is split into one group per owner file (id <group>--<file stem>, same folder), so a file whose own closure holds nothing moves. keep is that row's keep without the files main already holds with the same bytes once import paths are set aside (src/decision-store.mjs, src/record-model-tools.mjs, src/namespace-store.mjs, records/starting-rules.json, harness/setup.json and the reached parts/record-log and parts/eeaf files): a moved file imports main's copy, and none of them is copied or changed. Only groups that hold nothing are listed, each applied in a plan with only the groups of its lane, so every shared file they need lands too. Imports at the tag that named parts/ or src/ files an earlier move had already carried here (so they were missing at the tag) were set to those files' places here; nothing else in a moved file changed.
